In contrast, Candidate B, while capable, lacks significant command experience and has not demonstrated comparable success in managing complex public safety challenges or building community trust. Leadership experience and a track record of reform should take precedence over political considerations in a role of this critical public responsibility. Based on these factors, Candidate A is the stronger choice for the position.
